stations.title: Form PVC blister cavities
stations.does: Heat-form PVC film to create blister cavities for one 10-cavity strip.
steps: Load PVC film web into the forming zone
Heat and thermoform PVC to form 10 cavities in the blister footprint
Index the web forward by one strip length position

stations.title: Dose tablets into cavities
stations.does: Drop/dose tablets into each blister cavity.
steps: Present the thermoformed cavities under the dosing head
For each cavity: lower dispenser/nozzle to cavity mouth
Dispense tablets into the cavity (one-dose event per cavity)
Retract dispenser and hold until web indexes

stations.title: Camera-inspect filled cavities
stations.does: Use a camera to check every cavity is filled; identify strips containing any empty cavity.
steps: Trigger vision system at a fixed position on the indexed web
Capture image set across all 10 cavities
Evaluate cavity fill presence/absence vs acceptance criteria
If any cavity appears empty: mark this strip as REJECT for downstream diversion
If acceptable: clear strip for normal sealing

stations.title: Seal aluminium lid foil
stations.does: Heat-seal aluminium lid foil over the blister cavities.
steps: Feed lid-foil web above the indexed blister web
Lower sealing tool and/or bring heated platen to contact foil over cavities
Apply heat/pressure to form a continuous seal around cavity rims
Release platen and advance web to the next cut position

stations.title: Cut/trim into individual strips
stations.does: Cut/trim the sealed web into individual strips (separate the strips apart).
steps: Advance sealed web to the cutter position for strip boundaries
Execute cut/trim to separate individual 95×45 mm strips
Eject/transfer each strip onto the outfeed of the conveyor at one-strip pitch
For strips marked REJECT: divert to reject bin/chute at the same location

stations.title: Pack 2 strips + leaflet
stations.does: Place two finished strips into a folding carton and add the leaflet.
steps: Accumulate or buffer finished strips to form cartons of exactly two strips
For each carton: open a blank carton and stage it on the pack position
Pick/place first blister strip into carton interior
Pick/place second blister strip into carton interior
Pick/place leaflet into the carton
Close the folding carton flaps (manual or assisted closure per machine choice)
Complete carton handoff to outfeed

notes: Assumed takt is 1.0 s per finished blister strip (3600/h); each station is budgeted at 1 s to stay within takt. Real forming/sealing/cutting may require slower mechanical indexing; if so, the line rate must be reduced or the stations redesigned for higher parallel throughput.
Blister height was not provided; the model uses ~10 mm (per brief assumptions) but the twin may not need this for throughput unless cavity depth affects forming/sealing pressure.
Reject handling is implemented as a downstream diversion immediately after cutting; no rework is modeled (per your constraint).
